Definition: properly, to hide (as in the bosom), i.e. to cherish (with affection)
BiblicalUsage: Chabab is a tender word — to hide in the bosom, to cherish, to love fervently. Moses uses it once, in his blessing: God loved the people, and all His saints are in His hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the heart of the whole Bible — God does not merely rule His people, He cherishes them.
